rationale: Retire Amber Infrastructure's unsupported active ownership period and mark Iowa RNG realized in the PortCo database. Green Impact Partners' February 2023 announcement described a conditional strategic agreement under which Amber would purchase 50% of Iowa RNG only after project documents, non-recourse debt financing, return thresholds, regulatory approval and other closing conditions were satisfied. GIP's first-quarter 2023 financial statements separately recorded the completed GreenGas Colorado sale but continued to describe Iowa RNG as conditional. GIP's second-quarter 2024 MD&A then stated that Amber's exclusive rights to provide Iowa RNG equity expired on June 30, 2024 and had not been extended. GIP's Q3 2025 MD&A and current project page continue to present Iowa RNG as a GIP development seeking financing, with no Amber ownership disclosure or subsequent closing found. The retired period records a proposed 50% interest that did not close and retains a null exit year; this is an administrative correction of erroneous active ownership, not a historical divestiture.

identityResolution.projectBoundary: A three-dairy renewable natural gas development in northwest Iowa led by Green Impact Partners.
identityResolution.ownershipDecision: Amber's proposed 50% investment never became a supported closed ownership position; its exclusive equity-funding rights expired unextended on June 30, 2024.

acquisitionExitCheck.acquisitionSearch: The February 2023 strategic partnering agreement and GIP's Q1 2023 financial statements describe Amber's proposed Iowa RNG participation as conditional. The same financial statements expressly record the separate GreenGas Colorado closing but do not record an Iowa RNG sale.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentStatusSearch: GIP's Q2 2024 MD&A states that Amber's exclusive Iowa RNG equity-funding rights expired on June 30, 2024 and had not been extended. GIP's Q3 2025 MD&A reports no material Iowa RNG development and does not identify Amber as an owner. The current GIP project page continues to describe Iowa RNG as a GIP development securing financing.
